Dzhami "Jame" Ali (born August 23, 1998) is a Russian professional Counter-Strike 2 player and a former Counter-Strike: Global Offensive player. Jame is known for his slow and passive style of play and high success rate in clutches.

Trivia

[edit]

Personal

[edit]
  • On May 17, 2017, Jame, along with his team Hala Ares, were disqualified from CIS Minor Championship - Kraków 2017 due to naumoFF, one of his teammates, having an active VAC ban on one of his accounts. [3]

Awards

[edit]
  • Was ranked the 10th best player of 2021 by HLTV. [4]
  • Was ranked the 20th best player of 2022 by HLTV. [5]

MVPs

[edit]
  • Was named the HLTV MVP of 3 tournaments; including 1 Major:
    • BLAST Pro Series Moscow 2019 [6]
    • cs_summit 7 [7]
    • Intel Extreme Masters Rio Major 2022 [8]
